results.original_text: As a site editor, I want to have pretty good control over how the article, so that articles are visually appealing.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want comprehensive control over article formatting and layout so that I can ensure articles are consistently visually appealing and align with our brand standards.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editors can customize font styles, sizes, and colors with a preview option before publishing.
- The system allows drag-and-drop functionality for images and text blocks to adjust layout seamlessly.
- Changes to article formatting must be saved and applied in under 10 seconds.

Test Outline:
- Test the customization options for fonts and colors to ensure they match the brand style guide.
- Verify that drag-and-drop functionality works smoothly for all media and text elements.
- Measure the time taken for changes to be saved and applied to confirm it is within the 10-second limit.
results.correction_reason: The original user story lacked clarity regarding the specific controls and benefits. The revision explicitly defines the role of the site editor and articulates the desired capabilities with precise, measurable acceptance criteria. This approach strengthens the INVEST principles by ensuring the story is specific, valuable, and testable, providing clear guidance for implementation and validation.

User Story:
As a site editor, I want comprehensive control over article formatting and layout so that the articles are visually appealing and maintain a consistent style across the site.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editors can adjust font styles, sizes, and colors with a live preview feature.
- The system allows for customizable layout templates that editors can apply to articles.
- Changes to article formatting must be saved and reflected on the live site within 1 minute.

Test Outline:
- Verify that editors can change font styles, sizes, and colors and see real-time previews.
- Test the application of layout templates to ensure consistency in article presentation.
- Ensure that changes made to formatting are updated on the live site within the specified timeframe.

history.text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want comprehensive control over article formatting and layout so that I can ensure all articles are visually appealing and consistent with the site's design standards.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editors can modify text styles, including font type, size, and color, with a preview option.
- Editors can arrange multimedia elements (images, videos) with drag-and-drop functionality and alignment guides.
- The system must save formatting changes instantly and allow for easy reversion to previous versions.

Test Outline:
- Verify that editors can change text styles and view changes in real-time using the preview feature.
- Test multimedia arrangement to ensure drag-and-drop and alignment guides are functional and intuitive.
- Check that the system saves changes immediately and supports version control for formatting adjustments.
history.reason: The original user story was vague regarding the extent of control over article formatting. It has been rewritten to specify actionable abilities for editors, focusing on text and multimedia formatting capabilities. Measurable acceptance criteria were added to ensure the story is testable, defining explicit functions like style changes, multimedia management, and version control. This approach aligns the story with INVEST principles by making it specific, measurable, and valuable.
